status_definitions.admitted: The combination is inside the reviewed source profile; an exact release still needs its revision-bound evidence packet.
status_definitions.qualification_required: The interface or dependency is required, but no exact version or managed-service offering is supported until release qualification records it.
status_definitions.evaluation_only: Repository or CI coverage exists, but this combination is outside the first production profile.
status_definitions.excluded: The first production profile refuses this combination.
